source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀כִּי־ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah, for good [is it] to sing praises [to] our God, for pleasant, fitting [is] praise.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! For [it is] good to sing praises [to] our God; for [it is] pleasant, praise [is] fitting.
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! It is good to make music for our God; it is a delight, and praise is fitting.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! It is good to sing to our God. It is a delight, and praising {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} is the right thing to do.

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Car [il est] bon de chanter [pour] notre Dieu ; car [c’est] agréable, la louange [est] convenable.
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Il est bon de jouer pour notre Dieu ; c’est un bonheur, et la louange {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} convient.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! C’est bon de chanter pour notre Dieu. C’est une joie, et c’est juste de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer.

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Kwa maana [ni] vyema kumwimbia Mungu wetu sifa; kwa maana [ni] kupendeza, sifa [ni] ya kufaa.
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Ni vizuri kumpigia Mungu wetu muziki; ni furaha, na sifa zinafaa.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Ni vizuri kumwimbia Mungu wetu. Ni jambo la furaha, na kumsifu ni jambo linalofaa.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! Porque [es] bueno cantar alabanzas [a] nuestro Dios; porque [es] agradable, la alabanza [es] apropiada.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! Es bueno tocar música para nuestro Dios; es una delicia, y la alabanza es apropiada.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}! Es bueno cantarle a nuestro Dios. Es una delicia, y alabarlo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es lo que corresponde.

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Vì hát ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta [là] tốt lành; vì [điều đó] êm dịu, lời ca ngợi [là] xứng hợp.
vi.B: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Thật tốt lành khi đàn hát cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta; thật là vui thích, và lời ca ngợi thật xứng hợp.
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}! Hát cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta là điều tốt. Đó là niềm vui, và ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là điều đúng đắn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 참으로 우리 하나님께 찬송하는 것이 좋고, 참으로 [그것이] 즐거우니, 찬양이 마땅하다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 우리 하나님께 노래하며 연주하는 것은 좋은 일이다. 그것은 기쁜 일이니, 찬양은 마땅하다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라! 우리 하나님께 노래하는 것은 좋은 일이다. 그것은 기쁜 일이고, 그분을 찬양하는 것은 옳은 일이다.

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: hallelu-yah, a call to praise the LORD
decisions.reason: The words (hallelu yah) are a command to a group, "praise Yah"; Yah is the short form of the divine name (YHWH). Psalms 146-150 each open and close with this call. Here in Psalm 147 the renderings translate it, as "Praise the LORD", rather than keep it as the borrowed word "Hallelujah".

decisions.choice: for ... for: the reasons for praise, or "how"
decisions.reason: The small word ki usually means "for" or "because", giving the reason for the call to praise; it can also mark an exclamation, "how good!". Either way the line says that praising God is good and fitting.
"Pleasant" (na'im) most likely describes the singing, as in 135:3. It could also describe God, "for he is gracious".
The word (na'wah) is what suits or becomes someone; praise suits God's people (33:1).

source.text: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: Building Jerusalem [is] YHWH; [the] banished of Israel he gathers.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] building Jerusalem; the banished of Israel {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gathers.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is rebuilding Jerusalem; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is bringing together Israel's scattered exiles.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is building up Jerusalem again. He is bringing back the people of Israel who were driven away from their land.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] bâtissant Jérusalem ; les bannis d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les rassemble.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rebâtit Jérusalem ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rassemble les exilés dispersés d’Israël.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} reconstruit Jérusalem. Il ramène les Israélites qui avaient été chassés de leur pays.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaujenga Yerusalemu; waliofukuzwa wa Israeli anawakusanya.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaujenga upya Yerusalemu; anawakusanya pamoja watu wa Israeli waliotawanyika uhamishoni.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaujenga Yerusalemu tena. Anawarudisha watu wa Israeli waliofukuzwa kutoka nchi yao.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] edificando Jerusalén; a los desterrados de Israel {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reúne.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está reconstruyendo Jerusalén; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está juntando a los desterrados dispersos de Israel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está levantando de nuevo Jerusalén. Está trayendo de vuelta al pueblo de Israel que había sido expulsado de su tierra.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] xây dựng Giê-ru-sa-lem; những kẻ bị lưu đày của Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhóm lại.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang xây dựng lại Giê-ru-sa-lem; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nhóm họp những người Y-sơ-ra-ên bị tản lạc nơi lưu đày.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang xây dựng lại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngài đang đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người đã bị đuổi khỏi quê hương mình, trở về.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘을 세우시고, 이스라엘의 쫓겨난 자들을 모으신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘을 다시 세우시고, 흩어진 이스라엘의 포로들을 모으신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘을 다시 세우신다. 고향에서 쫓겨났던 이스라엘 백성을 다시 데려오신다.

decisions.reason: Isaiah 56:8 calls the LORD the one "who gathers the banished of Israel", in the same words.

decisions.choice: building Jerusalem, gathering exiles: the return from exile
decisions.reason: The words fit the time after the exile in Babylon, when the exiles came home and Jerusalem and its walls were rebuilt (Ezra 1; Nehemiah 2:17; 12:27). The psalm may have been sung then.
The word (nidchim) is people scattered and driven away from their land (Deuteronomy 30:4).
Balanced and Readable bring out that the city is being built again after its ruin (m2).

source.text: הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The one healing [the] broken of heart, and binding up their wounds.

en.L: [He is] the one who heals the broken of heart and binds up their wounds.
en.B: He heals those whose hearts are crushed and bandages their injuries.
en.R: He heals people whose hearts are broken, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} puts bandages on their wounds.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui guérit les brisés de cœur et qui panse leurs blessures.
fr.B: Il guérit ceux qui ont le cœur brisé et bande leurs plaies.
fr.R: Il guérit les gens qui ont le cœur brisé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} met des pansements sur leurs blessures.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayewaponya waliovunjika moyo na kuyafunga majeraha yao.
sw.B: Huwaponya wale ambao mioyo yao imepondeka na kuyafunga majeraha yao.
sw.R: Huwaponya watu wenye mioyo iliyovunjika, na kuyafunga majeraha yao kwa vitambaa.

es.L: [Él es] el que sana a los quebrantados de corazón y venda sus heridas.
es.B: Él sana a los de corazón destrozado y venda sus heridas.
es.R: Él sana a la gente que tiene el corazón roto, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les pone vendas en las heridas.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng chữa lành những người có lòng tan vỡ và băng bó vết thương của họ.
vi.B: Ngài chữa lành những người có tấm lòng tan nát và băng bó những vết thương của họ.
vi.R: Ngài chữa lành những người có tấm lòng tan vỡ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} băng bó những vết thương của họ.

ko.L: 마음이 상한 자들을 고치시고 그들의 상처를 싸매시는 분이시다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 마음이 부서진 사람들을 고치시고, 그들의 상처를 싸매 주신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 마음이 아픈 사람들을 낫게 하시고, 그들의 상처에 붕대를 감아 주신다.

decisions.choice: the broken of heart: people crushed by grief or shame
decisions.reason: A broken heart is a spirit crushed by sorrow, loss or guilt (34:19; 51:19).
Isaiah 61:1 speaks of one sent "to bind up the broken of heart", with the same words. The God who gathers his scattered people (verse 2) also heals them.
The verb (chavash) is to wrap a wound (Ezekiel 34:16).

source.text: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Counting [the] number of the stars; to all of them names he calls.

en.L: [He is] counting the number of the stars; to all of them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls names.
en.B: He decides how many stars there are and gives each one its name.
en.R: He knows exactly how many stars there are, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has a name for every one of them.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui compte le nombre des étoiles ; à toutes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne des noms.
fr.B: Il fixe le nombre des étoiles et donne à chacune son nom.
fr.R: Il sait exactement combien il y a d’étoiles, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a un nom pour chacune d’elles.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayehesabu idadi ya nyota; zote huziita majina.
sw.B: Huamua idadi ya nyota na kuipa kila moja jina lake.
sw.R: Anajua hasa idadi ya nyota zilizopo, na ana jina kwa kila moja yake.

es.L: [Él] cuenta el número de las estrellas; a todas ellas {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llama por nombre.
es.B: Él determina cuántas estrellas hay y da a cada una su nombre.
es.R: Él sabe exactamente cuántas estrellas hay, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene un nombre para cada una de ellas.

vi.L: [Ngài là Đấng] đếm số các ngôi sao; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi tên tất cả chúng.
vi.B: Ngài định số các ngôi sao và đặt tên cho từng ngôi một.
vi.R: Ngài biết chính xác có bao nhiêu ngôi sao, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có một cái tên cho mỗi ngôi sao.

ko.L: 별들의 수를 세시고, 그 모두를 이름으로 부르시는 분이시다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 별이 몇 개인지 정하시고, 하나하나에 이름을 붙여 주신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 별이 모두 몇 개인지 정확히 아시고, 별 하나하나의 이름을 다 아신다.

decisions.reason: In Isaiah 40:26 God brings out the stars by number and calls each one by name; no star is missing.

decisions.choice: counting the number: setting or knowing how many
decisions.reason: The words (moneh mispar) can mean that he counts the stars, or that he fixes their number. Either way, what no human can count (Genesis 15:5) he knows.
To give names is to know and to have authority over what is named (Genesis 2:19-20). The God who numbers the stars is the one who heals the broken (verse 3).

source.text: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Great [is] our Lord and abundant of strength; to his understanding there [is] no number.

en.L: Great [is] our Lord, and abundant in power; to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding [there is] no number.
en.B: Our Lord is great and mighty in power; there is no measuring {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding.
en.R: Our Lord is great and very powerful. There is no end to what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} understands.

fr.L: Grand [est] notre Seigneur, et abondant en force ; à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence [il n’y a] pas de nombre.
fr.B: Notre Seigneur est grand et d’une force immense ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence est sans mesure.
fr.R: Notre Seigneur est grand et très puissant. Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} comprend n’a pas de limite.

sw.L: Bwana wetu [ni] mkuu, na mwingi wa nguvu; ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [hauna] hesabu.
sw.B: Bwana wetu ni mkuu na mwenye uweza mwingi; ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hauwezi kupimwa.
sw.R: Bwana wetu ni mkuu na mwenye nguvu nyingi. Hakuna mwisho wa yale anayoyaelewa.

es.L: Grande [es] nuestro Señor, y abundante en poder; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} entendimiento no [tiene] número.
es.B: Nuestro Señor es grande y poderoso en fuerza; no hay medida para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} entendimiento.
es.R: Nuestro Señor es grande y muy poderoso. No hay límite para lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entiende.

vi.L: Chúa chúng ta [là] vĩ đại và dồi dào sức mạnh; sự hiểu biết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thì] không có số lượng.
vi.B: Chúa chúng ta thật vĩ đại và đầy quyền năng; sự hiểu biết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thể đo lường được.
vi.R: Chúa chúng ta thật vĩ đại và rất quyền năng. Sự hiểu biết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không có giới hạn.

ko.L: 우리 주님은 위대하시고 능력이 크시니, 그분의 지혜는 헤아릴 수 없다.
ko.B: 우리 주님은 위대하시고 능력이 크시니, 그분의 지혜는 잴 수가 없다.
ko.R: 우리 주님은 위대하시고 아주 강하시다. 그분께서 아시는 것은 끝이 없다.

decisions.reason: The word ('adon) is a master or lord; here, as often, it is used of God (8:2).
He knows the number of the stars (verse 4, the same word, mispar), but his own understanding has no number (Isaiah 40:28).
The title, not the divine name, so it is "주님" with no span (style guide section 7a), as in 135:5.

source.text: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Relieving [the] humble [is] YHWH, bringing low [the] wicked to [the] ground.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] relieving [the] humble, bringing [the] wicked down to the ground.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} lifts up the lowly and throws the wicked down to the earth.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} helps people who are humble, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knocks wicked people down to the ground.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] soutenant [les] humbles, abaissant [les] méchants jusqu’à terre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} relève les humbles et jette les méchants à terre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aide les gens humbles, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jette les méchants par terre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye kuwategemeza wanyenyekevu, akiwashusha waovu hadi chini.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwainua wanyonge na kuwatupa waovu chini ardhini.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwasaidia watu wanyenyekevu, lakini huwaangusha watu waovu chini.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sostiene a [los] humildes, abate a [los] malvados hasta el suelo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} levanta a los humildes y derriba a los malvados por tierra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ayuda a la gente humilde, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tira al suelo a la gente malvada.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] nâng đỡ [những người] khiêm nhu, hạ [những kẻ] ác xuống tận đất.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nâng đỡ những người khiêm nhu và quăng kẻ ác xuống đất.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ những người khiêm nhường, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quật ngã những kẻ gian ác xuống đất.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 겸손한 자들을 붙드시고, 악인들을 땅에 내던지신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 낮은 사람들을 일으켜 세우시고, 악인들을 땅바닥에 내던지신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 겸손한 사람들을 도와주시지만, 악한 사람들은 땅에 쓰러뜨리신다.

decisions.choice: the humble: the lowly who depend on God
decisions.reason: The word ('anawim) is the poor and powerless who look to God for help (22:27; 37:11).
The verb is the one used in 146:9 for the orphan and the widow.

source.text: עֱנ֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to YHWH with thanksgiving; sing praises to our God with [the] lyre,

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the lyre,
en.B: Sing out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with thanks; make music for our God on the lyre,
en.R: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! Play music on the lyre for our God.

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} avec action de grâce ; jouez pour notre Dieu sur la lyre,
fr.B: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} remerciant ; jouez pour notre Dieu sur la lyre,
fr.R: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et remerciez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Jouez de la lyre pour notre Dieu.

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa shukrani; mpigieni Mungu wetu muziki kwa kinubi,
sw.B: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sauti na kumshukuru; mpigieni Mungu wetu muziki kwa kinubi,
sw.R: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumshukuru! Mpigieni Mungu wetu muziki kwa kinubi.

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con acción de gracias; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música a nuestro Dios con la lira,
es.B: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} en voz alta {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con gratitud; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música para nuestro Dios con la lira,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:denle|dadle}} gracias a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música con la lira para nuestro Dios.

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với lời cảm tạ; hãy đàn ca cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta bằng đàn lia,
vi.B: Hãy cất tiếng hát cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy gảy đàn lia ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta,
vi.R: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Hãy gảy đàn lia cho Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.

ko.L: 감사함으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 수금으로 우리 하나님께 찬송하여라.
ko.B: 감사하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 수금을 타며 우리 하나님께 찬송하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하며 감사하여라! 수금을 타서 우리 하나님께 음악을 들려 드려라.

decisions.reason: The verb ('anah) usually means "answer"; here it is singing, perhaps singing back and forth (Exodus 15:21; Numbers 21:17). A new call to praise begins the second part of the psalm.
The kinnor was played with the hands or a pick, held while singing (33:2; 1 Samuel 16:23).
Verses 8-9 go on describing "our God", so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.
The commands to sing and make music are plural, spoken to the gathered people; Spanish marks them with the plural_you setting.
The established Korean word for the biblical lyre.

source.text: הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם׀בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: the one covering [the] heavens with clouds, the one preparing for the earth rain, the one causing to sprout [on the] mountains grass,

en.L: who covers [the] heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass sprout [on the] mountains,
en.B: who wraps the sky in clouds, who gets rain ready for the land, who makes grass sprout on the mountains,
en.R: He covers the sky with clouds and gets the rain ready for the earth. He makes grass grow on the mountains.

fr.L: qui couvre [les] cieux de nuages, qui prépare la pluie pour la terre, qui fait germer l’herbe [sur les] montagnes,
fr.B: qui enveloppe le ciel de nuages, qui prépare la pluie pour la terre, qui fait pousser l’herbe sur les montagnes,
fr.R: Il couvre le ciel de nuages et prépare la pluie pour la terre. Il fait pousser l’herbe sur les montagnes.

sw.L: anayezifunika mbingu kwa mawingu, anayeiandalia nchi mvua, anayeyachipusha majani [juu ya] milima,
sw.B: anayeifunika anga kwa mawingu, anayeiandalia nchi mvua, anayeyafanya majani yachipuke milimani,
sw.R: Huifunika anga kwa mawingu na kuiandalia dunia mvua. Huyafanya majani yaote milimani.

es.L: que cubre [los] cielos de nubes, que prepara la lluvia para la tierra, que hace brotar la hierba [en los] montes,
es.B: que envuelve el cielo en nubes, que tiene lista la lluvia para la tierra, que hace brotar la hierba en los montes,
es.R: Él cubre el cielo de nubes y prepara la lluvia para la tierra. Hace crecer la hierba en los montes.

vi.L: Đấng phủ mây trên [các] tầng trời, Đấng chuẩn bị mưa cho đất, Đấng làm cỏ mọc [trên các] núi,
vi.B: Đấng bao phủ bầu trời bằng mây, Đấng sắm sẵn mưa cho đất, Đấng làm cho cỏ mọc trên núi,
vi.R: Ngài phủ mây khắp bầu trời và chuẩn bị mưa cho đất. Ngài làm cho cỏ mọc trên núi.

ko.L: 그분은 하늘을 구름으로 덮으시고, 땅을 위하여 비를 마련하시며, 산에 풀이 돋게 하시는 분이시다.
ko.B: 그분은 하늘을 구름으로 감싸시고, 땅에 내릴 비를 준비하시며, 산마다 풀이 돋아나게 하시는 분이시다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 하늘을 구름으로 덮으시고, 땅에 내릴 비를 준비하신다. 산에 풀이 자라게 하신다.

decisions.reason: In a land that depends on rain for its crops, rain was seen as God's gift in its season (Deuteronomy 11:14; 104:13-14).

alternatives: grass, and plants for people's use (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation adds "and green plants for the service of human beings", words found in 104:14. The renderings follow the Hebrew text.
Readable starts new sentences and says who does this.

decisions.choice: The verse is a sentence of its own, "그분은 ... 분이시다" (verses 8-9)
alternatives: relative clauses on "our God" carried back into verse 7
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "who covers" describes the God of verse 7; a Korean relative clause must stand before its noun, so Korean starts again with "he" and keeps each verse's own content.

source.text: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: giving to [the] animals their food, to [the] young of [the] raven which call.

en.L: who gives the animals their food, [and] to the young of the raven that cry out.
en.B: who gives the beasts their food and feeds the raven's chicks when they call.
en.R: He gives food to the animals. He feeds the baby ravens when they cry for it.

fr.L: qui donne aux bêtes leur nourriture, [et] aux petits du corbeau qui crient.
fr.B: qui donne aux bêtes leur nourriture et nourrit les petits du corbeau quand ils appellent.
fr.R: Il donne de la nourriture aux animaux. Il nourrit les petits corbeaux quand ils crient pour en avoir.

sw.L: anayewapa wanyama chakula chao, [na] makinda ya kunguru wanaolia.
sw.B: anayewapa wanyama chakula chao na kuwalisha makinda ya kunguru wanapolia.
sw.R: Huwapa wanyama chakula. Huwalisha makinda ya kunguru wanapolilia chakula.

es.L: que da a los animales su alimento, [y] a las crías del cuervo que claman.
es.B: que da a las bestias su alimento y alimenta a los polluelos del cuervo cuando llaman.
es.R: Da comida a los animales. Alimenta a los cuervos pequeños cuando piden comida.

vi.L: Đấng ban cho súc vật thức ăn của chúng, [và] cho quạ con khi chúng kêu.
vi.B: Đấng ban thức ăn cho thú vật và nuôi những con quạ con khi chúng kêu.
vi.R: Ngài ban thức ăn cho thú vật. Ngài nuôi những con quạ con khi chúng kêu đói.

ko.L: 짐승들과 부르짖는 까마귀 새끼들에게 먹이를 주시는 분이시다.
ko.B: 들짐승들에게 먹이를 주시고, 울어 대는 까마귀 새끼들을 먹이시는 분이시다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 짐승들에게 먹이를 주신다. 아기 까마귀들이 먹이를 달라고 울면 먹여 주신다.

decisions.reason: God asks Job who feeds the raven when its young cry to God (Job 38:41). Jesus points to the ravens that God feeds (Luke 12:24).
The word (behemah) is animals, often cattle and other livestock (104:14).

source.text: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא־בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not in [the] strength of the horse he delights; not in [the] legs of the man he takes pleasure.

en.L: Not in the strength of the horse does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delight; not in the legs of the man does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} take pleasure.
en.B: It is not the power of the horse that delights {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, nor a soldier's strong legs that please {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: He is not impressed by powerful war horses or by soldiers with strong legs.

fr.L: Ce n’est pas dans la force du cheval qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se plaît ; ce n’est pas dans les jambes de l’homme qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend plaisir.
fr.B: Ce n’est pas la puissance du cheval qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît, ni les jambes solides d’un soldat qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} réjouissent.
fr.R: Il n’est pas impressionné par les chevaux de guerre puissants ni par les soldats aux jambes solides.

sw.L: Hapendezwi na nguvu za farasi; hafurahii miguu ya mtu.
sw.B: Si nguvu za farasi zinazomfurahisha, wala miguu imara ya askari inayompendeza.
sw.R: Havutiwi na farasi wa vita wenye nguvu wala na askari wenye miguu imara.

es.L: No en la fuerza del caballo se deleita {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; no en las piernas del hombre se complace {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: No es el poder del caballo lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada, ni las piernas fuertes del soldado lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} complace.
es.R: No {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} impresionan los poderosos caballos de guerra ni los soldados de piernas fuertes.

vi.L: Ngài không vui thích nơi sức mạnh của ngựa; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không đẹp lòng nơi đôi chân của người.
vi.B: Không phải sức mạnh của ngựa làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui thích, cũng chẳng phải đôi chân khỏe mạnh của người lính làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hài lòng.
vi.R: Ngài không coi trọng những con ngựa chiến mạnh mẽ hay những người lính có đôi chân khỏe.

ko.L: 그분께서는 말의 힘을 기뻐하지 않으시고, 사람의 다리를 좋아하지 않으신다.
ko.B: 그분을 기쁘시게 하는 것은 말의 힘이 아니고, 그분을 즐겁게 하는 것은 병사의 튼튼한 다리가 아니다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 힘센 군마나 다리가 튼튼한 군인들을 대단하게 여기지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: the horse and the man: strength for war
decisions.reason: Horses pulled chariots and carried riders in battle, and a soldier on foot needed strong, fast legs (2 Samuel 2:18). Kings trusted in such strength, but God does not (20:8; 33:16-17).

decisions.choice: the man: the warrior on foot
decisions.reason: The word ('ish) is a man; set beside the war horse, it pictures the foot soldier.
Balanced and Readable say what kind of man is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'homme" at Literal, with no gender setting, for the warrior on foot
decisions.reason: The ʾish here is the soldier who fights on foot beside the horse, as the meaning decision says; the English has no setting, and French keeps "l'homme" plainly.

source.text: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Taking pleasure [is] YHWH in those fearing him, in those who wait for his loyal love.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} takes pleasure in those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, in those who wait for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love.
en.B: What pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is people who revere {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and look with hope to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and count on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend plaisir en ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, en ceux qui espèrent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Ce qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, ce sont ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} révèrent et qui attendent avec espoir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se réjouit des gens qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent et qui comptent sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa na wale wanaomcha, na wale wanaoungojea upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Kinachompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni watu wanaomcha na kuutazamia kwa tumaini upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa na watu wanaomheshimu na kuutegemea upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se complace en los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen, en los que esperan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal.
es.B: Lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} es la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} reverencia y que espera con esperanza {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está contento con la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra y cuenta con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đẹp lòng những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, những người trông đợi tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Điều làm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đẹp lòng là những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hy vọng nơi tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hài lòng về những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và trông cậy vào tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분을 경외하는 자들, 그분의 한결같은 사랑을 바라는 자들을 기뻐하신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 것은 그분을 경외하고 그분의 한결같은 사랑을 바라는 사람들이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분을 두려운 마음으로 섬기고 그분의 변함없는 사랑을 믿고 기다리는 사람들을 기뻐하신다.

decisions.choice: taking pleasure: the answer to verse 10
decisions.reason: The same verb (ratsah) as in verse 10: God takes no pleasure in strength for war, but in people who fear him.
The verb (yachal) is to wait with hope (33:18, 22).
The word (chesed) is love that keeps faith, the commitment God has bound himself to toward his people (Exodus 34:6-7). Literal and Balanced say "loyal love".
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

source.text: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Extol, Jerusalem, YHWH; praise your God, Zion!

en.L: Extol {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion!
en.B: Jerusalem, glorify {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Zion, praise your God!
en.R: People of Jerusalem, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! People of Zion, praise your God!

fr.L: Célèbre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Jérusalem ; loue ton Dieu, Sion !
fr.B: Jérusalem, glorifie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Sion, loue ton Dieu !
fr.R: Habitants de Jérusalem, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Peuple de Sion, louez votre Dieu !

sw.L: Mtukuze {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Ee Yerusalemu; msifu Mungu wako, Ee Sayuni!
sw.B: Yerusalemu, mtukuze {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Sayuni, msifu Mungu wako!
sw.R: Watu wa Yerusalemu, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Watu wa Sayuni, msifuni Mungu wenu!

es.L: Ensalza {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Jerusalén; ¡alaba a tu Dios, Sion!
es.B: ¡Jerusalén, glorifica {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! ¡Sion, alaba a tu Dios!
es.R: Pueblo de Jerusalén, ¡alaba {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Pueblo de Sion, ¡alaba a tu Dios!

vi.L: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hỡi Si-ôn, hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời ngươi!
vi.B: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi Si-ôn, hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời ngươi!
vi.R: Hỡi dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hãy ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời các ngươi!

ko.L: 예루살렘아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높이 찬양하여라. 시온아, 너의 하나님을 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 예루살렘아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영광을 돌려라! 시온아, 너의 하나님을 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 예루살렘 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! 시온 사람들아, 너희 하나님을 찬양하여라!

decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation counts verses 1-11 as one psalm and verses 12-20 as another. The Hebrew text has one psalm, and the renderings follow it. A third call to praise begins here.

decisions.choice: extol, praise: commands to the city
decisions.reason: The commands are feminine singular: the city is addressed as a woman, as cities often are in Hebrew poetry (Isaiah 52:1-2).

decisions.choice: People of Jerusalem; People of Zion
decisions.reason: Readable says that the city's people are addressed.

decisions.choice: "vous" at Readable for the people of the city; "tu" to the city at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The commands are addressed to Jerusalem, a feminine city in Hebrew. Readable speaks to its people, as the English Readable does, so French changes to the plural.

The Hebrew commands are singular, spoken to the city. Readable names its people, as the English Readable does, but with the collective "pueblo" and a singular verb, so the city is still addressed as one and no plural_you setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" (L, B) for Jerusalem and Zion spoken to; "dân Si-ôn", "các ngươi" (R), as in Psalm 146:10
decisions.reason: The commands are to the city (see the meaning decision). As in Psalms 122 and 146, the city is "ngươi" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable speaks to its people, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּֽי־חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he has strengthened [the] bars of your gates; he has blessed your children in your midst.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has strengthened the bars of your gates; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has blessed your children within you.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made the bars of your gates strong and has blessed your children inside your walls.
en.R: He has made the bars on the city gates strong. He has blessed the people who live in the city.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a renforcé les barres de tes portes ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a béni tes enfants au milieu de toi.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu solides les barres de tes portes et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a béni tes enfants dans tes murs.
fr.R: Il a rendu solides les barres des portes de la ville. Il a béni les gens qui y habitent.

sw.L: Kwa maana ameyaimarisha makomeo ya malango yako; amewabariki watoto wako ndani yako.
sw.B: Kwa maana ameyafanya imara makomeo ya malango yako na kuwabariki watoto wako ndani ya kuta zako.
sw.R: Ameyafanya imara makomeo ya malango ya mji. Amewabariki watu wanaoishi mjini.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha reforzado los cerrojos de tus puertas; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha bendecido a tus hijos dentro de ti.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho fuertes los cerrojos de tus puertas y ha bendecido a tus hijos dentro de tus muros.
es.R: Él ha hecho fuertes los cerrojos de las puertas de la ciudad. Ha bendecido a la gente que vive en la ciudad.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho các then cổng của ngươi vững chắc; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban phước cho con cái ngươi ở giữa ngươi.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho then cổng của ngươi vững chắc, và đã ban phước cho con cái ngươi trong thành.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho các then cổng thành vững chắc. Ngài đã ban phước cho những người sống trong thành.

ko.L: 참으로 그분께서 네 성문의 빗장을 튼튼하게 하시고, 네 안에 있는 네 자녀들에게 복을 주셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 네 성문의 빗장을 굳게 하시고, 네 성벽 안에 사는 네 자녀들에게 복을 주셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 성문의 빗장을 튼튼하게 하셨다. 성 안에 사는 사람들에게 복을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: the bars of your gates: the city's defenses
decisions.reason: City gates were shut at night and in war and held by heavy bars (Nehemiah 3; Judges 16:3). Strong bars mean a city safe from attack.

decisions.choice: your children: the people of the city
decisions.reason: The "children" of a city are its people (149:2).

decisions.choice: the city gates; the people who live in the city
alternatives: your gates; your children within you
decisions.reason: Readable speaks about the city rather than to it, to keep the sentences plain.

source.text: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: The one making your border peace; [the] fat of wheat he satisfies you [with].

en.L: [He is] the one who makes your border peace; [with the] fat of wheat {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} satisfies you.
en.B: He keeps your frontiers at peace and satisfies you with the richest wheat.
en.R: He keeps the land around the city safe and peaceful. He gives its people plenty of the best wheat to eat.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui met la paix à ta frontière ; [de la] graisse du froment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te rassasie.
fr.B: Il garde tes frontières en paix et te rassasie du meilleur froment.
fr.R: Il garde le pays autour de la ville en sécurité et en paix. Il donne à ses habitants beaucoup du meilleur blé à manger.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayefanya mipaka yako [kuwa] amani; [kwa] unono wa ngano anakushibisha.
sw.B: Huilinda mipaka yako iwe na amani na kukushibisha kwa ngano iliyo bora kabisa.
sw.R: Huilinda nchi inayouzunguka mji iwe salama na yenye amani. Huwapa watu wake ngano bora kwa wingi.

es.L: [Él es] el que pone paz en tu frontera; [con lo] mejor del trigo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te sacia.
es.B: Él mantiene en paz tus fronteras y te sacia con el mejor trigo.
es.R: Él mantiene segura y en paz la tierra que rodea la ciudad. Da a su gente mucho del mejor trigo para comer.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng làm cho bờ cõi ngươi bình an; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho ngươi no nê [bằng] tinh hoa của lúa mì.
vi.B: Ngài giữ cho biên cương ngươi được bình an, và cho ngươi no nê lúa mì tốt nhất.
vi.R: Ngài giữ cho vùng đất quanh thành được an toàn và bình yên. Ngài ban cho dân thành thật nhiều lúa mì tốt nhất để ăn.

ko.L: 네 경계를 평화롭게 하시는 분이시니, 기름진 밀로 너를 배부르게 하신다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 네 국경을 평화롭게 지키시고, 가장 좋은 밀로 너를 배부르게 하신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 성 둘레의 땅을 안전하고 평화롭게 지켜 주신다. 그곳 사람들에게 가장 좋은 밀을 넉넉히 먹게 하신다.

decisions.choice: the fat of wheat: the best wheat
decisions.reason: "Fat" is the richest part, and so the best (81:17; Deuteronomy 32:14).
The word (gevul) is a border and also the land within it.

decisions.choice: the land around the city; its people
decisions.reason: As in verse 13, Readable speaks about the city rather than to it.

source.text: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The one sending his saying [to the] earth; very quickly runs his word.

en.L: [He is] the one sending {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command [to the] earth; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word runs very swiftly.
en.B: He issues {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} orders to the earth, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word goes out at a run.
en.R: He gives orders to the earth, and what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says happens right away.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui envoie {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ordre [sur la] terre ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole court très vite.
fr.B: Il envoie {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ordres à la terre, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole part en courant.
fr.R: Il donne des ordres à la terre, et ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit arrive tout de suite.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayetuma agizo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} [duniani]; neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} linakimbia upesi sana.
sw.B: Hutoa maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa dunia, na neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} hukimbia mbio.
sw.R: Huipa dunia amri, na anachosema hutokea mara moja.

es.L: [Él es] el que envía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mandato [a la] tierra; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra corre muy velozmente.
es.B: Él da {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} órdenes a la tierra, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra sale corriendo.
es.R: Él da órdenes a la tierra, y lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice sucede enseguida.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng sai mệnh lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [xuống] đất; lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạy rất nhanh.
vi.B: Ngài ban mệnh lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuống đất, và lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạy đi nhanh chóng.
vi.R: Ngài ra lệnh cho trái đất, và điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán xảy ra ngay lập tức.

ko.L: 땅에 그분의 명령을 보내시는 분이시니, 그분의 말씀이 매우 빨리 달린다.
ko.B: 그분께서 땅에 명령을 내리시니, 그분의 말씀이 달음질하듯 퍼져 나간다.
ko.R: 그분께서 땅에 명령하시면, 그분께서 말씀하신 일이 곧바로 이루어진다.

decisions.reason: The word ('imrah) is something said; here it is God's command to the world, which verses 16-18 show at work in snow, frost, hail and thaw.

decisions.choice: his word runs: what he says is done at once
decisions.reason: The word is pictured as a swift messenger. What God commands happens without delay (33:9; 148:8).

decisions.choice: what he says happens right away
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

source.text: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: The one giving snow like wool; frost like ash he scatters.

en.L: [He is] the one giving snow like wool; frost like ashes {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} scatters.
en.B: He sends snow that lies like wool and strews frost like ash.
en.R: He sends snow that looks like wool. He scatters frost like ashes from a fire.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui donne la neige comme de la laine ; le givre, comme de la cendre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le répand.
fr.B: Il envoie une neige pareille à la laine et répand le givre comme de la cendre.
fr.R: Il envoie de la neige qui ressemble à de la laine. Il répand le givre comme la cendre d’un feu.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayetoa theluji kama sufu; umande ulioganda kama majivu huutawanya.
sw.B: Huleta theluji iliyotandazwa kama sufu na kutawanya barafu ya asubuhi kama majivu.
sw.R: Huleta theluji inayoonekana kama sufu. Hutawanya barafu ya asubuhi kama majivu ya moto.

es.L: [Él es] el que da la nieve como lana; la escarcha como ceniza {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} esparce.
es.B: Él envía nieve que se extiende como lana y esparce la escarcha como ceniza.
es.R: Él envía nieve que parece lana. Esparce la escarcha como la ceniza de un fuego.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng ban tuyết như lông chiên; sương giá như tro, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rải ra.
vi.B: Ngài ban tuyết phủ như lông chiên và rắc sương giá như tro.
vi.R: Ngài sai tuyết xuống trông như lông chiên. Ngài rải sương giá như tro bếp.

ko.L: 양털 같은 눈을 주시는 분이시니, 재 같은 서리를 흩으신다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 양털처럼 쌓이는 눈을 내리시고, 재처럼 서리를 흩뿌리신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 양털처럼 보이는 눈을 내리신다. 불 탄 재처럼 서리를 흩으신다.

decisions.choice: snow like wool: white and thick
decisions.reason: Wool is a picture of whiteness (Isaiah 1:18) and also of a soft, thick covering.

decisions.choice: frost like ash: a fine powder strewn over the ground
decisions.reason: Frost lies on the ground like ashes scattered from a fire.

source.text: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Throwing his ice like crumbs; before his cold who will stand?

en.L: [He is] throwing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ice like crumbs; before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cold who can stand?
en.B: He flings down {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ice in pieces like crumbs; who can hold out against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} cold?
en.R: He throws down hail like little pieces of bread. No one can stand up to the cold {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sends.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui jette {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} glace comme des miettes ; devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} froid, qui tiendra ?
fr.B: Il lance {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} glace en morceaux comme des miettes ; qui peut résister à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} froid ?
fr.R: Il fait tomber la grêle comme de petits morceaux de pain. Personne ne peut tenir contre le froid qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoie.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayetupa barafu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama makombo; mbele ya baridi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ni nani awezaye kusimama?
sw.B: Huangusha barafu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} vipande vipande kama makombo; ni nani awezaye kustahimili baridi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.R: Hutupa mvua ya mawe kama vipande vidogo vya mkate. Hakuna awezaye kustahimili baridi anayoileta.

es.L: [Él] arroja {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hielo como migajas; ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} frío, ¿quién podrá resistir?
es.B: Él lanza {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hielo en pedazos como migajas; ¿quién puede aguantar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} frío?
es.R: Él hace caer el granizo como pedacitos de pan. Nadie puede resistir el frío que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envía.

vi.L: [Ngài] ném nước đá của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuống như những mẩu bánh vụn; trước cái lạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, ai đứng nổi?
vi.B: Ngài ném nước đá của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuống như những mẩu vụn; ai có thể chịu nổi cái lạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Ngài ném mưa đá xuống như những mẩu bánh nhỏ. Không ai chịu nổi cái lạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai đến.

ko.L: 그분의 얼음을 부스러기처럼 던지시니, 그분의 추위 앞에 누가 설 수 있겠는가?
ko.B: 그분께서 얼음을 빵 부스러기처럼 내던지시니, 누가 그분의 추위를 견딜 수 있겠는가?
ko.R: 그분께서는 작은 빵 조각 같은 우박을 내던지신다. 그분께서 보내시는 추위를 아무도 견딜 수 없다.

decisions.reason: The word (qerach) is ice; thrown down in bits, it is hail.
The word (pittim) is morsels of bread (Genesis 18:5 has the singular).

decisions.choice: who will stand: no one can
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "no one" (76:8; 130:3).

source.text: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: He sends his word and melts them; he makes blow his wind; waters flow.

en.L: He sends {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word and melts them; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind blow; [the] waters flow.
en.B: He sends {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word, and the ice thaws; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sets {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind blowing, and the waters run.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives an order, and the ice melts. He sends {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind, and the water flows again.

fr.L: Il envoie {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole et les fait fondre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait souffler {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent ; [les] eaux coulent.
fr.B: Il envoie {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole, et la glace fond ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait souffler {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent, et les eaux ruissellent.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne un ordre, et la glace fond. Il envoie {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent, et l’eau coule de nouveau.

sw.L: Hutuma neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na kuviyeyusha; huuvumisha upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; maji hutiririka.
sw.B: Hutuma neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, na barafu inayeyuka; huufanya upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} uvume, na maji yanatiririka.
sw.R: Kisha hutoa amri, na barafu inayeyuka. Hutuma upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na maji yanatiririka tena.

es.L: Él envía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra y los derrite; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace soplar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento; [las] aguas corren.
es.B: Él envía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra, y el hielo se derrite; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace soplar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento, y corren las aguas.
es.R: Luego {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} da una orden, y el hielo se derrite. Envía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento, y el agua vuelve a correr.

vi.L: Ngài sai lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra và làm chúng tan chảy; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khiến gió {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thổi; [các] dòng nước chảy.
vi.B: Ngài sai lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra, thì băng giá tan chảy; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho gió {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thổi, thì nước lại chảy.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra lệnh, thì băng tan. Ngài sai gió đến, thì nước lại chảy.

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 말씀을 보내셔서 그것들을 녹이시고, 그분의 바람을 불게 하시니, 물이 흐른다.
ko.B: 그분께서 말씀을 보내시면 얼음이 녹고, 그분께서 바람을 불게 하시면 물이 흐른다.
ko.R: 그러다가 그분께서 명령하시면 얼음이 녹는다. 그분께서 바람을 보내시면 물이 다시 흐른다.

decisions.choice: them: the snow, frost and ice
decisions.reason: "Them" are the snow, frost and ice of verses 16-17. The word that sent the cold also ends it.

decisions.choice: his wind: the warm wind he sends
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) is wind, breath and spirit; here it is the wind that brings the thaw.
Balanced and Readable say what melts (m1).

source.text: מַגִּ֣יד דְּבָרָ֣יו לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Declaring his words to Jacob, his statutes and his judgments to Israel.

en.L: [He is] declaring {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words to Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments to Israel.
en.B: He makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words known to Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings to Israel.
en.R: He has told {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words to Jacob's family, the people of Israel. He has given them {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decisions.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui déclare {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles à Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements à Israël.
fr.B: Il fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles à Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions à Israël.
fr.R: Il a dit {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles à la famille de Jacob, le peuple d’Israël. Il lui a donné {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayemtangazia Yakobo maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa Israeli.
sw.B: Humjulisha Yakobo maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na Israeli kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Amewaambia maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} watu wa ukoo wa Yakobo, yaani watu wa Israeli. Amewapa sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: [Él] declara {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras a Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios a Israel.
es.B: Él da a conocer {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras a Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos a Israel.
es.R: Él ha comunicado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras a la familia de Jacob, al pueblo de Israel. Les ha dado {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decisiones.

vi.L: [Ngài] rao truyền lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Gia-cốp, các luật lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và các phán quyết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ngài bày tỏ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Gia-cốp, các luật lệ và mệnh lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ngài đã truyền lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho dòng dõi Gia-cốp, tức là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài đã ban cho họ luật lệ và những phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분의 말씀을 야곱에게, 그분의 규례와 그분의 법도를 이스라엘에게 알리시는 분이시다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 그분의 말씀을 야곱에게 알리시고, 그분의 규례와 법도를 이스라엘에게 알려 주신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 야곱의 자손인 이스라엘 백성에게 그분의 말씀을 들려주셨다. 그들에게 그분의 법과 결정을 주셨다.

decisions.choice: his words: the words follow the form to be read
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this word in one form and its notes say to read it in another. The renderings follow the form to be read, "his words"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: his words: the same word that rules the weather
decisions.reason: The word (davar) that sends snow and thaw (verses 15, 18) is the word God has spoken to Israel. The God of creation is the God who gave Israel his law.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments: God's laws and rulings
decisions.reason: Two words for God's law (chuqqim, mishpatim), rendered as in Psalm 119: things he has laid down, and his just decisions.

decisions.choice: Jacob's family, the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jacob stands for his descendants.

records.literal_gloss: Not he has done thus for any nation, and judgments, they have not known them. Praise Yah!

en.L: Not so has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} done for any nation; and [as for] judgments, they have not known them. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: No other nation has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} treated this way; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings are unknown to them. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: He has not done this for any other nation. They have never known {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decisions. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Il n’a fait ainsi pour aucune nation ; et [quant aux] jugements, elles ne les ont pas connus. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Il n’a traité ainsi aucune autre nation ; {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions leur sont inconnues. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Il n’a pas fait cela pour une autre nation. Elles n’ont jamais connu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Hajafanya hivyo kwa taifa lolote; na [kwa habari ya] hukumu, hawazijui. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: Hajalitendea taifa jingine lolote namna hii; maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} hayajulikani kwao. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Hajafanya hivi kwa taifa jingine lolote. Hawajawahi kuyajua maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: No ha hecho {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} así con ninguna nación; y [en cuanto a sus] juicios, no los han conocido. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: Con ninguna otra nación ha actuado {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} así; {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos les son desconocidos. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: No ha hecho esto con ninguna otra nación. Ellas nunca han conocido {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decisiones. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: Ngài đã không làm như vậy cho một dân tộc nào; và [còn] các phán quyết, chúng đã không biết. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.B: Ngài chưa hề đối xử như thế với dân tộc nào khác; họ không biết các mệnh lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Ngài chưa làm điều này cho dân tộc nào khác. Họ chưa bao giờ biết những phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

ko.L: 그분께서는 어떤 민족에게도 이렇게 하지 않으셨으니, 그들은 [그분의] 법도를 알지 못하였다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.B: 그분께서는 다른 어떤 민족에게도 이렇게 하지 않으셨으니, 그들은 그분의 법도를 알지 못한다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!
ko.R: 그분께서는 다른 어떤 민족에게도 이렇게 해 주지 않으셨다. 그들은 그분의 결정을 한 번도 알지 못했다. {{divine_name:주|야}}를 찬양하여라!

decisions.reason: Moses asks what other nation has a god so near and laws so just (Deuteronomy 4:7-8). Israel's gift is to have been told God's ways.
The Hebrew says "judgments" without "his"; they are the judgments of verse 19.
Balanced and Readable say whose judgments are meant (m2).
